svg.title: The noodle lane, then and now
svg.desc: A narrow market lane of shophouses with a noodle stall, a queue, a packet-broth stall at the far end and a phone mast on a roof.

g.text: The noodle lane, then and now
The same forty metres. Eight things have gone. Three have not moved since 1998.
the stall that has not moved
